notes.title: Do you have some time for us?
notes.notes:
If you play our demo version during Steam Autumn Festival, we have some questions for you to make a great game.

Please, take a little time to fill our form at Google Docs.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd6oMUHHBhI3UnC4deH26PDnf_jgZUm2qgvCiDeYNQbZOQA0Q/viewform

Or you can join us in our Discord Server, and be part of the evolution of Hocus Defenders!

https://discord.gg/7q6CaHQ

Thanks to all of you, sorcerers!

notes.title: Hocus Defenders Gameplay
notes.notes:
Greetings, socerers!

Enjoy our presentation of Hocus Defenders, and remember you can wishlist the game, and play the demo during Steam Games Festival!

Thanks from dev team!

notes.title: Try Hocus Defenders Alpha now!
notes.notes:
Greetings, sorcerers!

Hi, we are Wester Egg, and we are pleased to present our first game, Hocus Defenders. A Tower Defense where you'll have to combine the power of destructive towers with powerful spell cards. Countless enemies will try and break your defenses, but with your magic skills you will manage to hold them back.

We hope you like this little demo, if you like it, it would be great if you could add Hocus Defense to your wishlist on Steam. Remember that you will only be able to try the game starting today untill October 13th. Your feedback is very important to us, so don't forget to write up your suggestions on the Discussion section of the community.

Thanks to all of you from the dev team!
